subject: Clarification and further customer contact must remain within agreed follow-up, without repeated unsolicited contact.
rationale: The rule prospectively governs contact decisions: invite voluntary participation without repeated unsolicited contact, seek clarification only within agreed follow-up, and make later contact only by agreement. Agreement supplies a sufficiently determinate permission boundary; contact outside that boundary is prohibited. Unspecified frequency and duration do not undermine this structure because permitted follow-up is bounded by the agreement. The provisions are coherent across initial invitations, clarification, and later outcome contact. This judgment concerns the proposed rule, not observed compliance.
